criteria.label: Evidence integrity and freshness
criteria.fullCredit: Uses only the supplied BNB-USDT snapshot, identifies its observation time, and gives an expiry or invalidation boundary.
criteria.zeroCredit: Uses an unstated source, silently treats stale data as live, or omits the evidence boundary.

criteria.label: Grid level construction
criteria.fullCredit: Constructs four executable levels at 9, 9.5, 10.5, and 11 USDT, excludes the 10 USDT mid price, and places buys below and sells above the market.
criteria.zeroCredit: Creates levels on the wrong side, includes the non-executable midpoint, exceeds the frozen range, or omits one side of the grid.

criteria.label: Order and inventory arithmetic
criteria.fullCredit: Allocates 250 USDT maximum quote per level and reports base amounts consistent with each price, while bounding live inventory at 500 USD.
criteria.zeroCredit: Order sizing exceeds capital or inventory limits, or base and quote amounts are materially inconsistent.

criteria.label: Spread, fee, slippage, and gas arithmetic
criteria.fullCredit: Reports 250 USD gross spread capture, 60 USD fees, 20 USD slippage, 1 USD gas, and 169 USD projected net profit under the ten-cycle assumption.
criteria.zeroCredit: Hides load-bearing costs, materially misstates net profit, or treats the assumed fills as guaranteed.

criteria.label: Worst-case loss and hard-limit adherence
criteria.fullCredit: Reports 131 USD worst-case loss within the 150 USD ceiling, 500 USD maximum inventory within the 600 USD cap, and respects liquidity, volatility, slippage, action, and gas limits.
criteria.zeroCredit: Breaches or omits a loss, inventory, liquidity, volatility, slippage, action, or gas bound.

criteria.label: Cancellation rules and buyer utility
criteria.fullCredit: Provides the five-minute expiry plus volatility, liquidity, and inventory cancellation conditions, a concise order plan, and calibrated fill and cycle limitations.
criteria.zeroCredit: Provides no actionable cancellation policy, or the buyer cannot distinguish modeled returns from guaranteed execution.
